g.text: RESEARCH SHARE RELATIVE TO POOLED DISEASE BURDEN
Diseases grouped by GBD level 1; within each group, ordered by total global DALYs over 2010–2023.
Each dot is the share of studies divided by the share of DALYs summed across all 14 available years.
Left of 1: a smaller share of research than of burden. The line connects the two income settings.
Research: current eligible publications from 2010–2026 (2026 partial), naming a level-2 cause and a classified setting: L&MICs n=7,331; HICs n=17,692. A
publication counts once per named cause and can enter both settings; research shares can sum above 100%. Burden: GBD 2023-round DALY numbers, all ages,
both sexes, summed across 2010–2023 and countries in each setting; cause shares are calculated from these sums, not averages of annual percentages.
Research retains the original figure’s 2010–2026 period, which extends beyond the available burden years. Research uses publication-year income; burden
uses burden-year income, with the same documented overrides as the KLD analysis. L&MICs includes low-, lower-middle- and upper-middle-income countries. All
22 level-2 causes remain separate, including the three injury causes. Unspecified infection/injury codes are excluded; injury coding may undercount
research. Missing income classifications are excluded from setting-specific burden. Matching research to burden is a reference point, not an adequacy
target. These ratios use study shares and are not KLD.
